Social Studies.fw: Iowa Academic Standards for Social Studies (2025)

std: Name the rules and responsibilities students have for different groups they are members of.
With teacher guidance, gather information from different sources and explain what they show about a topic.
Compare how people in different types of communities use goods from local and distant places to meet their daily needs.
Explain how different jobs in the community help meet people’s needs through goods and services.
Compare and contrast routes within communities using maps and other geographic models.
Describe ways people show belonging and citizenship in their community.
Explain why respecting others’ beliefs, traditions, and customs is part of being a good citizen.
Locate and explain physical features on a variety of maps.
Explain the roles of elected local and state officials.
Describe ways people can earn, spend and borrow money.
Describe symbols, places, or landmarks that make Iowa unique.
Describe Iowa’s natural resources and the consequences of using these resources.
Describe the origin, purpose, and impact of the Constitution and Bill of Rights.
Explain the processes by which laws are created, changed, limited, upheld, and removed.
